reason: Alert 1 (path-injection) alert-FP: resolved sink value is controlled by canonical path validation. User input 'param' flows through File constructor -> getCanonicalPath() -> norm. On the executed path, if param causes path traversal (e.g., ../../etc/passwd), norm would become /etc/passwd which fails the startsWith check, preventing Files.readAllBytes execution. The sink only executes when norm is proven safe (within base directory).
